blocks.title: Keyword arguments
blocks.text: Functions ko keyword arguments se bulaya ja sakta hai, har parameter ka naam le kar, jis se calls parhne mein aasan hoti aur arguments kisi bhi tarteeb mein diye ja sakte hain.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)

blocks.text: Output: My name is Ali and I am 20 years old. str(age) adad ko text banata hai ta ke doosri strings ke saath jora ja sake.

blocks.prompt: Call kyun chalti hai halanke age name se pehle diya gaya?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke har argument parameter ke naam se milaya jata hai, jagah se nahi.

items: Keyword arguments: call mein name=value; tarteeb ahem nahi.
